decisions.reason: After another year on offer without any negative signal, this core rye bread appears to meet aspiration levels and fits the firm's existing recipes, production and channels too well to justify withdrawal.

As a declared flagship with externally validated quality and strong consistency with the firm's confectionery identity, the premium raisin stollen is very likely performing above aspiration and should remain.

The seeded rye mixed bread is a close extension of the established assortment and, having remained on the market, is likely acceptable enough relative to aspirations to keep carrying at low incremental cost.

Although ancient grain bread is still the most experimental item, its survival through 2024 suggests results are not bad enough to trigger problemistic withdrawal, so boundedly rational management would continue the trial while monitoring demand.
